rules.decision: Use a Profile/Bot when the worker needs persistent identity, independent state, memory/history, model, tools, credentials, or recurring behavior.
Use delegate_task for short isolated fork/join work whose result returns to a parent and does not need durable independent workflow state.
Use Kanban when work must survive restarts, cross persistent agent boundaries, model dependencies, wait for humans/review, or remain auditable.
Use a Skill for reusable procedures, SOPs, domain knowledge, templates, and progressive-disclosure reference material.
Use AGENTS.md/.hermes.md-style project context for repository architecture, conventions, commands, and project-scoped rules.
Use SOUL.md for the persistent Profile's identity, mission, role boundary, and operating philosophy.
Use Cron for scheduled/recurring execution; hand durable cross-agent lifecycle to Kanban or another workflow state machine.
Use built-in tools or MCP for external capabilities, with per-role tool filtering and explicit credential boundaries.
Use execute_code for deterministic multi-tool loops, filtering, branching, and aggregation when intermediate outputs should stay out of model context.
Use an actual sandbox/container/backend and technical capability restrictions for execution isolation; a Profile is only a Hermes-state boundary.
